title: What's new in v2.6.0
summary: Every WAN gets its own health score, and its own alerts.

steps.title: Multi-WAN monitoring
steps.listLabel: Every WAN watched, graded and probed on its own
steps.body: Your WANs are already here, each with its own live throughput. Give one a vantage and it gets its own targets, upstream characterization and ISP Health score.

steps.title: Any moment, either view
steps.listLabel: Jump from any moment on the timeline straight to the charts
steps.body: Park the timeline on the moment you care about, then hit the magnifier to open **Latency & Packet Loss** framed on that exact instant.

steps.title: And back again
steps.body: This icon does the reverse: it takes the moment you are analyzing and plays it back on **Live View**.

steps.title: WAN outage alerts
steps.listLabel: Knows whether your line dropped or something upstream did
steps.body: Every target on the WAN is weighed together, so an outage arrives as one confirmed alert that says whether the link itself went or only part of the path beyond it.

steps.title: Starlink alerts
steps.listLabel: Obstruction, aim drift and outages, straight from the dish
steps.body: Obstruction climbing, a dish no longer pointed where it needs to be, outages with the cause the dish reports, even on a backup nothing else is watching. Turn them on under **Rules**.

steps.title: Smart Queues check
steps.listLabel: Smart Queues (SQM) that UniFi Network never actually turned on
steps.body: Smart Queues (SQM) can read as on in UniFi Network while no shaper is running on your gateway. **Analyze** now catches that and tells you how to fix it.

steps.title: Restarts and alerts, on the charts
steps.listLabel: See what happened to a device right where its numbers changed
steps.body: Marks on **Device Health** show every restart and alert. Hover one for the reason - power loss, a firmware upgrade, a crash or kernel panic - and **SFP Stats** and **ONT Stats** carry their own. (Check **7d** or **30d** to see recent restarts or firmware upgrades.)
